messages:
maria_g: Heads up — getting multiple support tickets about requests failing with 502/504 for hosted-infer in us-west-2. SLO alert just fired: p99 latency + 5xx spike. Users report sudden failures on steady traffic, started ~11:02 PDT. Dashboard: /dashboards/slo/hosted-infer-usw2 shows probe SLO trending fine but real traffic SLO burning.

alex_s: looking. seeing a 5xx spike in ingress logs too. Probes still green for the health check path but actual routes to /v1/generate are spiking 502. Could be probe != realpath mismatch. Adding traces.

jack_r: can you paste a sample query? running a quick slice.

alex_s: query I ran:
```
index=ingress_logs environment=prod region=us-west-2 route="/v1/generate" | timechart count by status_code
```
Shows a burst of 502/504 between 11:01-11:06.

emily_ops: I see a cluster of TCP RSTs on the edge LB to backend connections around the same window. suspect keepalive mismatch + backend closing idle connections -> RST mid-request. Probes use short stub path and keepalive is different.

support_lead: support stack reports customers see 502 with no response body, some report retries succeed. Ticket examples included.

maria_g: that's consistent with connection reset behavior. But why probes are green? they use /healthz, very lightweight, maybe served by different code path or cached route.

jack_r: ran a curl repro against a long-ish request with streaming:
```
curl -v -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate" -d '{"prompt":"spam\n"}' --header "Authorization: Bearer X" --max-time 30
```
I saw connection closed by peer after 8s on some tries -> 502 at gateway.

alex_s: digging into the load balancer config. Found LB idle_timeout=10s, backend keepalive=60s for some pods, but a subset of older nodes have keepalive=5s due to an older config bundle. That would cause half-open resets for requests that take longer than 5s.

emily_ops: also seeing sampling gap in traces for these requests — trace IDs for failed ones aren't making it through. Likely due to the RSTs happening before sidecar can emit spans. That explains the trace gap complaints.

sre-bot: SLO_ALERT: hosted-infer-usw2 p99 latency > 2s, 5xx rate > 0.8% (window 5m). Notified #oncall.

maria_g: proposed immediate mitigations: 1) bump LB idle_timeout to 65s; 2) patch older node config to keepalive=60s; 3) temporarily route traffic away from the affected node pool (canary) while we fix. Thoughts?

jack_r: agree. Quick rollback-safe approach: route traffic to dedicated fallback model variant with faster responses for 10m while we remediate. But we should fix keepalive first, that's the root.

alex_s: I'll trigger a config rollout to the node pool now (patch the configmap and restart ingress pods). If rollout fails, we'll shift routing.

emily_ops: while alex patches, I'll increase tracing sampling to 100% for the /v1/generate route for 15 minutes so we capture any failing spans.

alex_s: patch applied to configmap and rolling restart started for ingress nodes in pool-a. Rolling restart 3/6 done.

sre-bot: deployment:ingress-config updated by alex_s — roll restart in progress.

maria_g: support — let customers know we're investigating; suggested temporary retry guidance and we will follow up.

support_lead: sent status update to affected customers. Added note about retries and ETA 20m.

jack_r: ingress nodes now all back up. LB idle_timeout increased to 65s. I'm observing 5xx dropping back to baseline in the next minute.

alex_s: confirm: post-fix logs show no RST cluster and 502s reduced. traces are coming in now for previously failed requests.

emily_ops: sampling increase captured several failing traces — we can see the RST mid-stream on the tcp layer. Pulled a trace sample and saved to /traces/2380012345/sample-1.json.

maria_g: SLOs look stable. SRE follow-ups: 1) create a dashboard comparing probe vs realpath health by route to catch probe-mismatch earlier; 2) add an alert rule for LB/backend keepalive divergence; 3) add runbook entry for this pattern (keepalive mismatch causing 502 RST).

jack_r: I'll own the runbook and dashboard. assigning to me and linking to this thread.

support_lead: customers have been notified with a post-incident note. No escalations open now.

maria_g: thanks everyone. Closing the alert window but keeping enhanced tracing for 30m. If we see any reoccurrence we'll reopen. :thumbsup:

alex_s: also add a check during config promotions to ensure keepalive settings are consistent across node pools — opened PR https://git.internal/r/redwood/infra/keepalive-consistency (WIP).

sre-bot: SLO_ALERT_RESOLVED: hosted-infer-usw2 — metrics back within thresholds.

maria_g: final action items in thread:
- jack_r: runbook + dashboard + alert rule (ETA EOD)
- alex_s: config promotion PR + pre-promotion check (ETA tomorrow)
- emily_ops: follow-up on trace retention and ensure sampling revert (ETA 30m)
- support_lead: customer wrap-up note (done)

maria_g: tagging @oncall for visibility. thanks all.
